name: Historic Centre of Florence
description: Florence, in Tuscany, Italy, grew from an Etruscan settlement into the cradle of the Renaissance, thriving under the wealthy Medici family in the 1400s and 1500s. Its compact centre is packed with masterpieces, from the great cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore to Santa Croce, the Uffizi and the Pitti Palace. Walking its streets means meeting the legacy of Giotto, Brunelleschi, Botticelli and Michelangelo.
